description: Global shared thematic taxonomy; 20 active topics, with two legacy deprecated aliases. Private course topics belong in curriculum manifests.

categories.label: Abstract & General Concepts
categories.description: General matters, issues, ideas, and nonphysical concepts referred to in everyday conversation and learning.

categories.label: Animals & Weather
categories.description: Animals, weather conditions, and the natural environment.

categories.label: Communication & Social Language
categories.description: Greetings, requests, apologizing, thanking, and speaking with others.

categories.label: Daily Actions & Activities
categories.description: Common everyday actions, physical activities, and routines.

categories.label: Family & Relationships
categories.description: Relatives, family life, friendship, and relationships.

categories.label: Food, Drinks & Meals
categories.description: Meals, eating, drinking, ingredients, and restaurants.

categories.label: Grammar & Function Words
categories.description: Particles, markers, and general structural or discourse words lacking a useful thematic domain.

categories.label: Health & Wellbeing
categories.description: Illness, medical care, sleep, and rest.

categories.label: Home, Clothing & Objects
categories.description: Home interiors, everyday belongings, clothing, and household objects.

categories.label: Leisure, Music & Media
categories.description: Films, music, games, recreation, and entertainment.

categories.label: Numbers & Quantities
categories.description: Counting, amounts, measurements, ordinals, and classifiers.

categories.label: People & Identity
categories.description: People, gender, personal information, and forms of address.

categories.label: Places, Position & Direction
categories.description: Countries, positions, directions, and spatial relations.

categories.label: Qualities, Feelings & Evaluation
categories.description: Descriptors, personal feelings, properties, and judgments.

categories.label: Pronouns, Questions & Pointing
categories.description: Personal and demonstrative pronouns; asking and pointing.

categories.label: Education & Language
categories.description: Learning, school, teachers, reading, writing, and languages.

categories.label: Shopping & Money
categories.description: Stores, prices, buying, selling, and currency.

categories.label: Time & Calendar
categories.description: Dates, times of day, periods, age and scheduling.

categories.label: Travel & Transport
categories.description: Vehicles, travel, driving, and going from place to place.

categories.label: Work & Jobs
categories.description: Workplaces, occupations, and the working day.

categories.label: Time, Frequency & Repetition
categories.description: Communicating temporal references, the number of occurrences, recurring events and repetition.

categories.label: Vocabulary & Grammar Patterns
categories.description: Exploring established words and reusable grammatical constructions, lexicalization, register and usage distinctions.
